newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Diesel extends Outboard Marine offer.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Diesel extends Outboard Marine offer.

text.p: Detroit Diesel Corp said Monday it has extended its tender offer for Outboard Marine Corp until August 25 at Outboard Marine's request.
Last week, a Greenway Partners affiliate said it was starting an $18 a share tender offer, $2 a share higher than Detroit Diesel's offer for Outboard Marine.
The Detroit Diesel tender offer was originally scheduled to expire Monday.
About 1.9 million shares of Outboard Marine common stock had been validly tendered and not withdrawn as of the close of business Friday, Detroit Diesel said.
Outboard Marine shares were up 3/16 at 17-15/16 Monday and Detroit Diesel shares were down 4/16 at 25-1/16.
